issues.title: Order total is off by a cent on some orders
issues.body: `orders/total.py` sums floats and rounds with `round`, so 3 × 0.35 gives 1.05 on one order and 1.04 on another. Done when the total rounds half up, in Decimal.

issues.title: The docstring of `vat` says cents, but it returns euros
issues.body:
## Where

`billing/tax.py:4`: the docstring of `vat` says "Returns the VAT on amount, in cents."

## How it shows up

`vat` returns `amount * 0.20`, quantized to `0.01`, as a `Decimal` in euros. Its only caller, `get_invoice_total` in `billing/invoice.py:5`, adds it to an order total in euros. A reader who trusts the docstring can divide the result by 100, or multiply the input by 100, and get a wrong invoice total.

## Fix

Change the docstring to say that the result is in euros, as a `Decimal` rounded to the cent.

## Why it was out of scope

Found in the review of the fix for #14, which changes only `orders/`. This file is in another module.

issues.title: sign_up treats emails that differ only in case as two accounts
issues.body:
## Where

`accounts/signup.py:4`: `sign_up` checks and stores the email as typed.

## How it shows up

`sign_up("Bob@shop.test", h)` and then `sign_up("bob@shop.test", h)` both succeed. One person gets two accounts, and the check `if email in USERS` does not stop the second one.

## Fix to decide

Normalize the email before the check and the store, for example with `email.strip().lower()`, and add a test for the case above. Decide if the stored value keeps the case as typed, and what happens to accounts that exist already with mixed case.

## Why it was out of scope

Found in the review of the fix for #14, which changes only `orders/`. This file is in another module.
